core_principles: Objective truth and clarity above all else.
Tension through high-contrast grayscale and singular bold color accents.
Grid-based structural layout. Expose the skeleton.
Never use full-screen gradients. Texture and solid blocks over gloss.

rules: Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Line height: leading-none for headings, leading-relaxed for body.
No generic bolding; use font-black for extreme contrast, font-light for elegance.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 extensively. Grid layout everywhere.

grid_modes.marketing_sections: Mode A: The Tetris Grid (Asymmetrical, gap-8 to gap-12)
grid_modes.dashboard_and_reviews: Mode B: The Control Room Grid (Dense, gap-4 to gap-6, utilized 100%)

surface_styles.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (border-zinc-200), NO shadow by default. Hover: shadow-sm and border-zinc-900.
surface_styles.radius: Minimal roundness. rounded-none or rounded-md (4px) max. Avoid heavily rounded UI.
surface_styles.header: Crystal Glass. bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-zinc-200.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-none font-semibold hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 rounded-none hover:border-zinc-900 transition-colors
buttons.outline: border-2 border-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 rounded-none hover:bg-zinc-900 hover:text-white transition-colors

forms.inputs: bg-zinc-50 border border-zinc-200 rounded-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:border-transparent text-zinc-900

badges.verified: bg-green-100 text-green-800 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1
badges.category: bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-900 rounded-none px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase

motion.interactions: Crisp and fast. hover:-translate-y-1 transform transition-all duration-200.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for review lists and grid items.

assets.icon_library: lucide-react (default) OR @phosphor-icons/react for duotone technical look.

backgrounds.description: Abstract black and white flowing fabric texture

testing.attributes: All interactive/informational elements MUST include data-testid. Format: kebab-case, role-based. e.g., data-testid='submit-review-button'

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use Inter for headings. Include Cabinet Grotesk from fontshare or similar font API.
All media URLs provided MUST be used instead of placeholders. No dummyimage.com allowed.
Focus on stark contrast. Use the border-zinc-200 aggressively for structural separation.
The layout must feel like a high-end editorial tech site, not a cheap directory template.
Use Shadcn UI but aggressively strip the 'Vercel look' by applying rounded-none or rounded-sm and removing generic box shadows.
